entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I need to make a return.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF886-12B.
Thank you, Alex. I've pulled up your order. I see the VeloPro cycling shoes. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They just don't fit right. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but after any ride over an hour, I start getting terrible blisters on my heels.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the delivery date here... one moment.
Okay, I see the shoes were delivered 63 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Okay, a full refund is good. I appreciate that. Now, since I've had to deal with the discomfort and the hassle of calling in, would it be possible to also get a 10% discount code for my next purchase? I'd like to try a different model.

I understand your position, Alex. While I can't add a discount code on top of the full refund, I can assure you the return process will be simple. I'm generating a prepaid return label to send to your email on file right now. You'll get your money back as soon as we receive the cycling shoes at our warehouse.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. As long as the refund is processed smoothly, that's what's most important. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. The email with the label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Have a great day, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
